```json
{
  "id": 1
}
```

Images are limited to 20 MB.

<a id="change-security"></a>

### `change_security`

Change accounts and privilege sets, as Manage Security does, all or none. Ops: {op:"setAccount", name, privilegeSet?, mustChange?} (creates or changes an account; passwords are never set here: people set their own, or the administrator uses tabularius passwd), {op:"setExternalAccount", name: group, privilegeSet}, {op:"deleteAccount", name}, {op:"savePrivilegeSet", set: a privilege set as get_security shows it}, {op:"deletePrivilegeSet", name}, {op:"setPasswordPolicy", policy} (it may keep or raise the minimum password length, never lower it), {op:"disableTotp", account}, {op:"createExtendedPrivilege", name} / {op:"updateExtendedPrivilege", extendedPrivilege: name or id, name} / {op:"deleteExtendedPrivilege", extendedPrivilege} (a custom "way in" a privilege set can grant, Manage Security's Extended Privileges tab). API tokens are managed in Manage Security. Returns the result as get_security does.

**Hints:** destructive

**Permissions:** [Full Access] in the file, or the server administrator; any other privilege set (even one that can modify scripts) is refused, and so is a scoped API token.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | string | yes | Hosted database name |
| `changes` | array of object of any | yes | The changes, applied together or not at all, each {op, ...} as the description lists (at least 1 items) |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "name": "change_security",
  "arguments": {
    "database": "Invoices",
    "changes": [
      {
        "op": "setAccount",
        "name": "Clerk",
        "privilegeSet": "Viewers"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "database": "Invoices",
  "accounts": [
    {
      "name": "Admin",
      "hasPassword": true,
      "privilegeSet": "[Full Access]",
      "hasTotp": false,
      "blankPassword": false,
      "unmigrated": false
    },
    {
      "name": "Clerk",
      "hasPassword": true,
      "privilegeSet": "Viewers",
      "hasTotp": false,
      "blankPassword": false,
      "unmigrated": false
    }
  ],
  "privilegeSets": [
    {
      "name": "[Full Access]",
      "id": 1,
      "records": {
        "view": true,
        "edit": true,
        "create": true,
        "delete": true
      },
      "layouts": "modifiable",
      "valueLists": "modifiable",
      "scripts": "modifiable",
      "extendedPrivileges": [
        "fmapp",
        "fmwebdirect",
        "fmrest"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Viewers",
      "records": {
        "view": true,
        "edit": false,
        "create": false,
        "delete": false
      },
      "layouts": "viewOnly",
      "valueLists": "viewOnly",
      "scripts": "viewOnly",
      "extendedPrivileges": [
        "fmapp"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "passwordPolicy": {},
  "minPasswordLength": 12,
  "apiTokens": []
}
```

A privilege set's table entry can mark a field masked (fields: {Field: "masked"}, with masks: {Field: {kind: "last4" | "placeholder", text?}}); a mask is accepted only for a masked field. Also takes createExtendedPrivilege, updateExtendedPrivilege and deleteExtendedPrivilege (a custom "way in" a privilege set can grant); those are applied first, as design changes recorded under the account "AI". Any change carrying a password, and revokeApiToken, is refused. Since no password can be given, setAccount only changes an existing account: a new name fails with 'No account "…" (give it a password to create it)'.

<a id="create-database"></a>

### `create_database`

Start a new, empty database on this server (no FileMaker file needed), then build it with change_design. Set a password for its first account with `tabularius passwd` before people log in.

**Permissions:** The server administrator only (the --mcp-token bearer, the server's MCP token, or stdio); every account and API token is refused.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | Database name: letters, digits, spaces, - and _ |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "name": "create_database",
  "arguments": {
    "name": "ReferenceScratch"
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "database": "ReferenceScratch"
}
```

The new file starts with no accounts: give its first account a password with `tabularius passwd` before people sign in.

<a id="sync-status"></a>

### `sync_status`

Where syncing hosted files with FileMaker Server stands: for each file with a sync setup, the FileMaker Server it syncs with, the tables, whether sending and bringing in are allowed, what the latest check found (counts, and records changed on both sides with the fields that differ but not their values), the scheduled syncs, and which of them are waiting on a decision. Read-only: conflicts are settled and writes started by an administrator in the admin console's Sync page.

**Hints:** read-only

**Permissions:** Only the administrator's own client (the server's MCP token); never an account. Read-only: an administrator settles conflicts and starts writes in the admin console's Sync page. Shows only files with AI turned on. Record values, passwords and password file paths are never shown.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | string | no | Only this hosted file |
| `log` | boolean | no | Also the last 20 lines of the sync log (what was sent and brought in) |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "name": "sync_status",
  "arguments": {
    "database": "Shop"
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "database": "Shop",
      "server": "fms.example.com",
      "remoteDatabase": "Shop",
      "tables": [
        "Contacts"
      ],
      "allowWrites": true,
      "allowPulls": false,
      "allowContainers": false,
      "running": false,
      "passwordSaved": true,
      "last": {
        "at": "2026-10-15T08:00:00.000Z",
        "trigger": "scheduled",
        "tables": [
          {
            "table": "Contacts",
            "toSend": 2,
            "toBringIn": 1,
            "sent": 0,
            "broughtIn": 0,
            "failed": 0
          }
        ],
        "conflicts": 1,
        "conflictsListed": [
          {
            "table": "Contacts",
            "uuid": "7c1f…",
            "kind": "both-changed",
            "fields": [
              "Phone"
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      "schedules": [
        {
          "name": "Sync Shop",
          "enabled": true,
          "mode": "check only",
          "everyMinutes": 60,
          "lastRun": {
            "at": "2026-10-15T08:00:00.000Z",
            "result": "1 to send, 1 to bring in, 1 conflict",
            "conflicts": 1
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "waitingOnADecision": [
    {
      "schedule": "Sync Shop",
      "database": "Shop",
      "at": "2026-10-15T08:00:00.000Z",
      "conflicts": 1
    }
  ]
}
```

## Resources

Resource templates, read with `resources/read`; `{database}` is a hosted file, checked as for tools.

| URI | Type | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tabularius://{database}/schema` | application/json | A file's tables and fields, layouts, scripts and value lists, as this account sees them. |
| `tabularius://{database}/overview` | text/markdown | A readable map of a solution: tables, relationships, scripts buttons start, scripts that reach outside. |
| `tabularius://{database}/conversion-guide` | text/markdown | What won't work until changed after converting from FileMaker, what works differently, and what to use instead. |
| `tabularius://{database}/scripts/{script}` | text/plain | A script as FileMaker shows it in the script workspace, with secrets hidden; requires permission to view the script. |
| `tabularius://{database}/layouts/{layout}` | application/json | A layout's fields, types, value lists, ranges, common values and portals, as this account sees them. Data samples are omitted while personal data isolation is on. |
| `tabularius://{database}/automations` | application/json | A file's automations, their triggers and recent runs; [Full Access] only. Hidden and refused while personal data isolation is on. |
| `tabularius://{database}/audit` | application/json | Up to 100 audit entries, oldest first, with secret field values hidden; [Full Access] only. Hidden and refused while personal data isolation is on. |

## Prompts

| Prompt | Arguments | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `explain_solution` | `database` | A plain-language tour of a FileMaker solution: what it is for, its data, its screens and its scripts. |
| `find_in_plain_english` | `database`, `request`, `layout` (optional) | Turn a request like "customers in Ohio with unpaid invoices" into a FileMaker find and run it. |
| `draft_calculation` | `database`, `layout`, `goal` | Write a FileMaker calculation for a goal, checked against the real fields and data. |
| `draft_script` | `database`, `goal` | Write a FileMaker script for a goal, in the style of the solution's own scripts. |
| `review_security` | `database` | Check a solution's accounts and privilege sets for real risks, worst first ([Full Access] only). |
| `after_converting` | `database` | What to fix first in a newly converted file, worst first, with the built-in replacement for each. |
| `clean_up_data` | `database`, `table` (optional) | Find duplicates, stray spaces, inconsistent spellings and other data problems, and fix them as one undoable step. |
| `what_would_break` | `database`, `change` | Before renaming or deleting a field, table, layout or script: everything that uses it. |
| `suggest_rules` | `database`, `table` | Rules a table's data already follows (required fields, value lists, ranges), to add as field options. |
| `make_dashboard` | `database`, `want` | A dashboard of the numbers someone asks for, saved so people can open it in the web client. |
| `who_changed` | `database`, `question` | Who changed records or the design, and what changed, from the audit log and design history ([Full Access] only). |
